# California Education Code § 49501.5(a)

According to the statute, commencing with the 2022-23 school year, school districts, county superintendents, and charter schools must "make available a nutritionally adequate breakfast and a nutritionally adequate lunch free of charge" to pupils who request meals without regard to their eligibility for federal assistance programs.
